Thanks for the demo last week — MedDevCo is moving quickly on the evaluation and procurement side. As part of our security intake we need:

2) Legal basis: subprocessing / data processing addendum (DPA) with subprocessors, plus standard customer contracts; we'll provide contract effective dates in the SIG export.

3) SOC 2 summary updated: added the period (2026-04-01 to 2026-09-30) and auditor (NorthPoint LLP). Attached: SOC2_TypeII_summary_20261115.pdf. The attached summary contains the scope statement and control families tested. Full report requires NDA and one-time secure transfer.

4) SIG XLSX: we will prepare a redacted SIG export (PII and vendor POCs redacted) and upload both the redacted and the full (locked) versions to our secure S3 transfer location. Link: s3://redwood-sec-transfer/meddevco/RDW-EXP-4921/ (one-time, access will be provisioned to the MedDevCo security group).
